snippet.title: Magic River (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/magic-river/id1003415673

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.magicriver

Move through the river without hitting any obstacles! Explore different locations while drifting down the river! Collect gems to unlock awesome new characters and boats!
